info.name: 🚀 FlowOps — Complete Test Suite
info.description:
# FlowOps Complete API Test Suite

Full end-to-end test suite covering all 9 modules.

## How to Use
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Import the `FlowOps_Environment.postman_environment.json` file
3. Select the **FlowOps Local** environment from the top-right dropdown
4. Run folder by folder (Day 1 → Day 2 → Day 3) **OR** use Collection Runner for bulk/automated testing

## Test Flow
The requests are chained — each request auto-saves tokens/IDs into environment variables for the next request.

## Default Test Credentials
- Admin: `admin@flowops.com` / `admin123`
- Driver: `driver@flowops.com` / `password`
- Customer: `customer@flowops.com` / `password`
